objectives:
本課程旨在讓學生認識並了解人力資源管理在組織中的各項要素、基本原則與重要角色。本課程同時重視理論與實務，為學生建立紮實的人力資源管理基礎。
課程將採用講授、參與式學習及個案教學等方式進行，學習重點將聚焦於課堂中對人力資源管理核心概念的討論，以及與相關主題案例的分析。課程要求學生進行簡報、小組討論、課堂參與，並完成期末考試。
content:
1 (9/10)	Class Introduction
2 (9/17)	Introduction to Human Resource Management and Strategic HRM
Suggested reading: McDonnell, A., Carbery, R., Burgess, J., & Sherman, U. (2021). Technologically mediated human resource management in the gig economy. The International Journal of Human Resource Management, 32(19) 3995–4015.
3 (9/24)	Case 1: People Transformation: the UOB Way
4 (10/1)	The Legal Environment; Job Analysis and Design
Suggested reading: Demerouti, E., & Bakker, A. B. (2023). Job demands-resources theory in times of crises: New propositions. Organizational Psychology Review, 13(3), 209-236.
5 (10/8)	HR Planning and Recruitment; Selection and Placement
Suggested reading: Horodyski, P. (2023). Applicants' perception of artificial intelligence in the recruitment process. Computers in Human Behavior Reports, 11, 100303.
6 (10/15)	Case 2: Recruitment of a Star
7 (10/22)	Training; Performance Management
Suggested reading: Fernandes, C., Veiga, P. M., Lobo, C. A., & Raposo, M. (2023). Global talent management during the COVID‐19 pandemic? The Gods must be crazy!. Thunderbird International Business Review, 65(1), 9-19.
8 (10/29)	Case 3: Now&Me: Rethinking Performance Metrics for Mental Health Experts
9 (11/5)	Employee Development; Employee Separation and Retention
Suggested reading: Jamal, M. T., Anwar, I., Khan, N. A., & Ahmad, G. (2024). How do teleworkers escape burnout? A moderated-mediation model of the job demands and turnover intention. International Journal of Manpower, 45(1), 169-199.
10 (11/12)	Sports Day (No Class)
11 (11/19)	Pay Structure Decisions and Recognizing Employee Contributions with Pay
12 (11/26)	Employee Benefits
Suggested reading: Jolly, P. M., McDowell, C., Dawson, M., & Abbott, J. (2021). Pay and benefit satisfaction, perceived organizational support, and turnover intentions: The moderating role of job variety. International Journal of Hospitality Management, 95, 102921.
13 (12/3)	Case 4: Name Your Price: Compensation Negotiation at Whole Health Management
14 (12/10)	Collective Bargaining; Managing HR Globally
Suggested reading: Horak, S., & Paik, Y. (2023). Informal network context: deepening the knowledge and extending the boundaries of social network research in international human resource management. The International Journal of Human Resource Management, 34(12), 2367-2403.
15 (12/17)	Review
16 (12/24)	Final Exam
books:
Textbook: Noe R.A., Hollenbeck, J.R., Gerhart, B., & Wright, P.M. (2022). Human Resource Management: Gaining a Competitive Advantage
(13th edition). McGraw-Hill Companies, Inc.

*4 Harvard Business Cases
*7 Journal articles
grading_policy:

Final Exam: 20％
Group Presentations: 20％
Case Analyses: 25％
